007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
012
013/** Demonstrates granting run access to an owner-managed team through the client API. */
014public final class GrantTeamAccessSample {
015
016    private GrantTeamAccessSample() {
017    }
018
019    /**
020     * Grants the configured database user or role permission to run a team.
021     *
022     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
023     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails; the process exits unsuccessfully
024     */
025    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
026        String teamName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_SHARED_TEAM_NAME");
027        String grantee = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_SHARED_TEAM_GRANTEE");
028        try (SelectAIAgent client = createClient()) {
029            boolean granted = client.grantTeamAccess(teamName, grantee);
030            System.out.printf("Team access grant completed: %s%n", granted);
031            System.out.printf("Team: %s%n", teamName);
032            System.out.printf("Grantee: %s%n", grantee);
033        }
034    }
035
036    private static SelectAIAgent createClient() throws SelectAIException {
037        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
038                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
039                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
040                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
041                .build());
042    }
043
044    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
045        String value = System.getenv(name);
046        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
047            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
048        }
049        return value;
050    }
051}
